dialogues.jp: うららかだ。
dialogues.en: It's bright.
dialogues.text: It's bright.

dialogues.jp: 春って、どうしてこんなに気持ちがいいんだ？
dialogues.en: I wonder why spring always feels so nice?
dialogues.text: I wonder why spring always feels so nice?

dialogues.jp: 隣には環がいる。
dialogues.en: There's Tamaki too, by my side.
dialogues.text: There's Tamaki too, by my side.

dialogues.jp: そうか……。俺達、デートしてるんだっけ。
dialogues.en: That's right... we're supposed to be on a date.
dialogues.text: That's right... we're supposed to be on a date.

dialogues.jp: 何か、今日の環、いつもと雰囲気が違うな。
dialogues.en: But hm... today, Tamaki didn't seem herself.
dialogues.text: But hm... today, Tamaki didn't seem herself.

dialogues.jp:
環の服、胸のボタンが外れてる。教えてあげる
べきだよな。でも……。
dialogues.en: A button had dropped from her shirt. I should tell her...
dialogues.text: A button had dropped from her shirt. I should tell her...

dialogues.jp: どうやって教えよう？
dialogues.en: ...But how can I, without being rude?
dialogues.text: ...But how can I, without being rude?

dialogues.jp: うわっ、見えそうで見えないな。
dialogues.en: W, wah... I shouldn't be looking either.
dialogues.text: W, wah... I shouldn't be looking either.

dialogues.jp: 教えると、俺が見てると思われるかな。
dialogues.en:
If I tell her, I'd also let her know that I'm looking
there...
dialogues.text:
If I tell her, I'd also let her know that I'm looking
there...

dialogues.jp: 見てない訳じゃないし……。
dialogues.en: It's not that I was especially looking there, but...
dialogues.text: It's not that I was especially looking there, but...

dialogues.jp:
手をつなぐの？　いや、俺の手、汗ばんでるし
……。
dialogues.en: We're holding hands? And my palm feels so sweaty...
dialogues.text: We're holding hands? And my palm feels so sweaty...

dialogues.jp: どうしよう。なんか、今日の環……積極的だぞ。
dialogues.en: Man... Tamaki seems so... forward, today.
dialogues.text: Man... Tamaki seems so... forward, today.

dialogues.jp:
いつもと様子がおかしい。顔を間近で見ると、
変な気持ちになりそう。
dialogues.en:
Her expression was weirder too. The closer I look at her
face, the more unknown feelings welled up inside me.
dialogues.text:
Her expression was weirder too. The closer I look at her
face, the more unknown feelings welled up inside me.

dialogues.jp: 瞳に引き込まれそう。
dialogues.en: Her eyes seemed intent on sucking me into them for eternity.
dialogues.text: Her eyes seemed intent on sucking me into them for eternity.

dialogues.jp: 環の唇、綺麗だな……。
dialogues.en: Her lips are beautiful as well...
dialogues.text: Her lips are beautiful as well...

dialogues.jp: 俺、変なところばっか見てるよな。
dialogues.en: What am I doing, looking at her like this...
dialogues.text: What am I doing, looking at her like this...

dialogues.jp:
ま、まだ付き合ってもないのに、なんでこんな
にドギマギしてるんだ？
dialogues.en: W, we're not dating yet, so why am I getting so flustered?
dialogues.text: W, we're not dating yet, so why am I getting so flustered?

dialogues.jp: 俺、怪しいのかな。
dialogues.en: There's something wrong with me today too.
dialogues.text: There's something wrong with me today too.

dialogues.jp: やばい……。おかしくなりそう。
dialogues.en: Damn... this is all so weird.
dialogues.text: Damn... this is all so weird.

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「目線が、イヤらしいよ……」
dialogues.en: "Your eyes seem unpleasant..."
dialogues.text: "Your eyes seem unpleasant..."

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「げげえっ！　環がしわくちゃに！」
dialogues.en: "G, gaaaah! Tamaki got old and wrinkly!"
dialogues.text: "G, gaaaah! Tamaki got old and wrinkly!"

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「うるさい子だね。これでも心は乙女だよ」
dialogues.en: "How rude! I still have the heart of a young girl!"
dialogues.text: "How rude! I still have the heart of a young girl!"

dialogues.jp: ……。なんで、夢にばあちゃんが。
dialogues.en: ...It's just grandma, in my dreams.
dialogues.text: ...It's just grandma, in my dreams.

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp:
「こうやって、デートなんかするんじゃ、いく
　ら記憶を封印したって、ダメだね」
dialogues.en: "Make sure you don't forget the memory of this date, boy."
dialogues.text: "Make sure you don't forget the memory of this date, boy."

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「ど、どういうことだよ、ばあちゃん」
dialogues.en: "W, what do you mean, grandma?"
dialogues.text: "W, what do you mean, grandma?"

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp:
「さあね……。ま、好きにおし。それだけでか
　くなっちゃ、神さまも文句は言えないだろう
　からね」
dialogues.en:
"Who knows... just do as you like. Even God won't be able to
say anything to whatever you do."
dialogues.text:
"Who knows... just do as you like. Even God won't be able to
say anything to whatever you do."

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.en: "Haah?"
dialogues.text: "Haah?"

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「神さまは、若い子が好きってことさ」
dialogues.en: "Because God likes kids."
dialogues.text: "Because God likes kids."

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「わけわかんねーよ」
dialogues.en: "I don't understaaand."
dialogues.text: "I don't understaaand."

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「わかんなくて、いいっつってんだろ」
dialogues.en: "It'd be better that way."
dialogues.text: "It'd be better that way."

dialogues.jp: そこで、ふっと目が覚めた。
dialogues.en: My eyelids flew open.
dialogues.text: My eyelids flew open.

dialogues.jp:
上半身を起こすと、いつもの見慣れた自分の部
屋だった。
dialogues.en:
I lifted myself to a sitting position on my bed, and looked
around at the usual scenery of my room.
dialogues.text:
I lifted myself to a sitting position on my bed, and looked
around at the usual scenery of my room.

dialogues.jp:
なんだ……夢か。しかも、他人の夢ではなく、
自分の夢。
dialogues.en:
I guess... it was a dream. Not someone else's dream either,
just mine.
dialogues.text:
I guess... it was a dream. Not someone else's dream either,
just mine.

dialogues.jp: なんか、久しぶりに見た気がする。
dialogues.en: The dream seemed... familiar somehow.
dialogues.text: The dream seemed... familiar somehow.

dialogues.jp: でも、今の夢って……。
dialogues.en: But that dream was...
dialogues.text: But that dream was...

dialogues.jp:
かなり、妄想入ってたよな。しかも……総天然
色。サラウンド方式ってか。
dialogues.en:
It must've been just my imagination. But... the vivid
colour. The surround sound.
dialogues.text:
It must've been just my imagination. But... the vivid
colour. The surround sound.

dialogues.jp: まあ、後半はホラー映画に変わったわけだが。
dialogues.en: ...Although the second half changed into a horror movie.
dialogues.text: ...Although the second half changed into a horror movie.

dialogues.jp:
俺がベッドで呆然としていると、コンコンと部
屋をノックする音が聞こえる。
dialogues.en:
I continued to sit thinking in bed, when a knock on my door
shook me out of my stupor.
dialogues.text:
I continued to sit thinking in bed, when a knock on my door
shook me out of my stupor.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、おはよ」
dialogues.en: "Good morning, nii-san."
dialogues.text: "Good morning, nii-san."

dialogues.jp: 入ってきたのは、音夢だった。
dialogues.en: Nemu entered my room.
dialogues.text: Nemu entered my room.

dialogues.jp: 「おう」
dialogues.en: "Morn'."
dialogues.text: "Morn'."

dialogues.jp: 俺はまだ、夢の世界から抜けきっていない。
dialogues.en: I was still half in dreamland.
dialogues.text: I was still half in dreamland.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どうしたの？　変な顔して」
dialogues.en: "Is somehting wrong? Your face looks bad."
dialogues.text: "Is somehting wrong? Your face looks bad."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なあ、音夢。お前も妄想する時ってある？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Nemu... do you ever get, you know.. thoughts?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Nemu... do you ever get, you know.. thoughts?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「妄想？　どんな妄想？」
dialogues.en: "Thoughts? What thoughts?"
dialogues.text: "Thoughts? What thoughts?"

dialogues.jp: そう返されると答えようもないのだが……。
dialogues.en: That doesn't tell me anything...
dialogues.text: That doesn't tell me anything...

dialogues.jp: 「例えば、仮想デートとか……」
dialogues.en: "Like, an imaginary date..."
dialogues.text: "Like, an imaginary date..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「仮装デート？　ハロウィンのこと？」
dialogues.en: "An imaginary date? You mean like 31st February?"
dialogues.text: "An imaginary date? You mean like 31st February?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「『かそう』違いじゃ」
dialogues.en: "That's not quite what I meant by imaginary..."
dialogues.text: "That's not quite what I meant by imaginary..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「？？？　よくわかんないよ、兄さん」
dialogues.en: "??? I'm clueless, nii-san."
dialogues.text: "??? I'm clueless, nii-san."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうだろうな。俺もよくわからん」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, I am too."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, I am too."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あのねぇ……」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「つまり、妄想は身体によくないってことだ」
dialogues.en: "Not good for myself to think about it too much."
dialogues.text: "Not good for myself to think about it too much."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「変な妄想じゃないでしょうね？」
dialogues.en: "They weren't weird thoughts, were they?"
dialogues.text: "They weren't weird thoughts, were they?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「すごく微妙なラインだったと思う」
dialogues.en: "I'd say it was toeing the line."
dialogues.text: "I'd say it was toeing the line."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「何なんですか、もう！　とにかく！」
dialogues.en: "...You didn't have to say that much, geez! In any case!"
dialogues.text: "...You didn't have to say that much, geez! In any case!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「休みだからって寝すぎだよ。そろそろ起きて
　もらわないと……」
dialogues.en:
"Even if it's break time, you've slept way too long. If you
don't get up now..."
dialogues.text:
"Even if it's break time, you've slept way too long. If you
don't get up now..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「了解した」
dialogues.en: "Understood."
dialogues.text: "Understood."

dialogues.jp: 音夢は部屋のドアを閉めて、出て行った。
dialogues.en: Nemu went out of my room, closing the door behind her.
dialogues.text: Nemu went out of my room, closing the door behind her.

dialogues.jp: 一人になり、もう一度夢について思い出す。
dialogues.en: Alone again, my thoughts wandered back to that dream.
dialogues.text: Alone again, my thoughts wandered back to that dream.

dialogues.jp: 結構、楽しめたよな……。
dialogues.en: Seemed like I was having fun...
dialogues.text: Seemed like I was having fun...

dialogues.jp: い、いかん、また妄想が……。
dialogues.en: ...Uh oh, I'm getting those thoughts again...
dialogues.text: ...Uh oh, I'm getting those thoughts again...

dialogues.jp: 俺って、欲求不満？
dialogues.en: Am I... frustrated, there?
dialogues.text: Am I... frustrated, there?

dialogues.jp:
とにかく、家を脱出しないことには、妄想に取
り付かれてしまう。
dialogues.en:
I should get out of this house... I'd just become more and
more obsessed at this rate.
dialogues.text:
I should get out of this house... I'd just become more and
more obsessed at this rate.

dialogues.jp:
お日様の下を歩いていれば、そんな妄想たちも
浄化されるだろう。
dialogues.en:
Breathing the air outside, and feeling the sun's rays,
should purify my mind.
dialogues.text:
Breathing the air outside, and feeling the sun's rays,
should purify my mind.

dialogues.jp: 安らかに眠りたまえ……。
dialogues.en: And then I'd be able to sleep peacefully...
dialogues.text: And then I'd be able to sleep peacefully...

dialogues.jp: と、書店の前を通りかかる。
dialogues.en: I ended up idly walking past a bookshop.
dialogues.text: I ended up idly walking past a bookshop.

dialogues.jp: すると、妄想の原因が自動ドアから出てきた。
dialogues.en:
Just my luck, the source of those thoughts came walking
right out of the door.
dialogues.text:
Just my luck, the source of those thoughts came walking
right out of the door.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あら、朝倉様……」
dialogues.en: "My, Asakura-sama..."
dialogues.text: "My, Asakura-sama..."

dialogues.jp: 巫女装束姿の環は手に本屋の紙袋を持っている。
dialogues.en:
She was clad in her usual Miko costume, holding a bag of
books.
dialogues.text:
She was clad in her usual Miko costume, holding a bag of
books.

dialogues.jp: 「よう」
dialogues.en: "Hey."
dialogues.text: "Hey."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「お買い物ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Would you be shopping?"
dialogues.text: "Would you be shopping?"

dialogues.jp:
環は、俺の妄想など露知らず、いつも通り話し
かけてくる。
dialogues.en:
Utterly ignorant of my thoughts, she continued on with
everyday chatter.
dialogues.text:
Utterly ignorant of my thoughts, she continued on with
everyday chatter.

dialogues.jp: 「本、何か買ったのか？」
dialogues.en: You were buying books?"
dialogues.text: You were buying books?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あ、はい」
dialogues.en: "Ah, yes..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, yes..."

dialogues.jp: 環は急に、赤面して俯いている？
dialogues.en: ...Huh? She suddenly started blushing.
dialogues.text: ...Huh? She suddenly started blushing.

dialogues.jp: そんな恥ずかしい質問したか？
dialogues.en: Was that such an embarassing question?
dialogues.text: Was that such an embarassing question?

dialogues.jp:
まさか、そんな恥ずかしい本でも買ったのだろ
うか？　手にした紙袋が気になる。
dialogues.en:
Don't tell me the books she bought were embarassing? Now I'm
really interested in that bag...
dialogues.text:
Don't tell me the books she bought were embarassing? Now I'm
really interested in that bag...

dialogues.jp:
追及するのもどうかと思うが、確かめたいので
聞いてみる。
dialogues.en:
But to confirm the crime, one must ascertain the evidence
first.
dialogues.text:
But to confirm the crime, one must ascertain the evidence
first.

dialogues.jp: 「な、何の本？」
dialogues.en: "What kind of book?
dialogues.text: "What kind of book?

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「えっと、料理の本です」
dialogues.en: "Erm, a cookbook..."
dialogues.text: "Erm, a cookbook..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "I see..."
dialogues.text: "I see..."

dialogues.jp: でも、料理の本なら、赤面することないよな。
dialogues.en: But a cookbook isn't anything to get red over.
dialogues.text: But a cookbook isn't anything to get red over.

dialogues.jp: 環はまだ、下を向いている。
dialogues.en: She was still hiding her face, too.
dialogues.text: She was still hiding her face, too.

dialogues.jp: そんなに恥ずかしい料理の本って、何だ？
dialogues.en: What kind of embarassing cookbooks are there?
dialogues.text: What kind of embarassing cookbooks are there?

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「明日のデート、よろしくお願いします」
dialogues.en: "...Let's have fun on tomorrow's date."
dialogues.text: "...Let's have fun on tomorrow's date."

dialogues.jp: 環は急に頭を下げる。
dialogues.en: She suddenly give me a bow.
dialogues.text: She suddenly give me a bow.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、こちらこそ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, we will."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, we will."

dialogues.jp: 俺もつられて頭を下げる。
dialogues.en: I poiltely bowed back as well.
dialogues.text: I poiltely bowed back as well.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「では、また明日」
dialogues.en: "T, then, see you tomorrow."
dialogues.text: "T, then, see you tomorrow."

dialogues.en: Eh?!
dialogues.text: Eh?!

dialogues.jp: もう行っちゃうの？
dialogues.en: She's going already?
dialogues.text: She's going already?

dialogues.jp: なんだか、いつもよりそっけなくないか？
dialogues.en: Why so early this time?
dialogues.text: Why so early this time?

dialogues.jp: 「お、おう」
dialogues.en: "O, okay..."
dialogues.text: "O, okay..."

dialogues.jp:
環は、軽くお辞儀をすると、逃げるように俺の
元から去っていく。
dialogues.en:
She gave me another small bow, then briskly walked past me
and behind.
dialogues.text:
She gave me another small bow, then briskly walked past me
and behind.

dialogues.jp:
俺の中には、世界の七不思議に勝るとも劣らぬ
謎だけが残されてしまった。
dialogues.en:
In my head, the seven wonders of the world has been replaced
by a far more mystifying phenomena.
dialogues.text:
In my head, the seven wonders of the world has been replaced
by a far more mystifying phenomena.

dialogues.jp: 恥ずかしい料理の本って……何？？？
dialogues.en: What in the world could make a cookbook embarassing???
dialogues.text: What in the world could make a cookbook embarassing???

dialogues.jp: ◆本の中身は？◆
dialogues.en: ◆Within the Book is??◆
dialogues.text: ◆Within the Book is??◆

dialogues.jp:
環とのデートを明日に控えた緊張からか、やけ
に妄想めいた夢を見る。
dialogues.en:
With a date with Tamaki tomorrow fresh in my mind, I had a
weird dream.
dialogues.text:
With a date with Tamaki tomorrow fresh in my mind, I had a
weird dream.

dialogues.jp:
ついでに、ばあちゃんの夢も見る。恋愛映画と
ホラー映画の豪華二本立て。
dialogues.en:
It involved my grandma too. Half a romance movie, half a
horror movie, you could say.
dialogues.text:
It involved my grandma too. Half a romance movie, half a
horror movie, you could say.

dialogues.jp:
家にいても落ち着かないので、商店街に行くと、
環が本を買っていた。
dialogues.en:
Since I couldn't calm down at home, I went to the shopping
district, and met Tamaki shopping for books.
dialogues.text:
Since I couldn't calm down at home, I went to the shopping
district, and met Tamaki shopping for books.

dialogues.jp:
何の本かと聞くと、料理の本だと言っていたが、
知られたくないのかそそくさと行ってしまう。
dialogues.en:
I found out she had bought cookbooks, but she then hurriedly
left.
dialogues.text:
I found out she had bought cookbooks, but she then hurriedly
left.

dialogues.jp: そんなに恥ずかしい本でも買ったのか？
dialogues.en: She bought such an embarassing cookbook?
dialogues.text: She bought such an embarassing cookbook?
